defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It applies a Kruskal-style minimum-spanning-forest strategy to connect required components, which can select cheap edges in branches containing no required site instead of pruning those branches from the tree.

It starts Prim's algorithm from a required site and expands across the entire graph, thereby computing a spanning tree for all sites rather than stopping at the minimal subtree spanning only the required sites.
